stop: Stop after the nuisance grid (main delta 0.08 x 5 probe sets, delta sweep on v2) and the T0 A2 scale-up: they decide whether active probing returns as a headline (docs/board/nuisance.md thresholds: >= 5 % ambiguous after v2, >= 30 % relative cut by a probe).
_doc: Role nuisance. Task cfcap/nuisance_task.py:TASK (nuisance-marginalised T1 SMC posterior, 192 particles, <= 100 tempering stages, 64 draws -> rho_dec = rho_abs/rho_ref (primary) and rho_rel (secondary) q05/q95 per child/merge/leg) and :A2_TASK (T0 A2/A3 oracle episodes by seed block). unit_s are ESTIMATES, not box measurements: the local 4070 pilot was still queued behind the shared GPU lock when this plan was written. Basis: per episode <= 100 stages x 6 SMC sim batches x 192 particles (~115k probe sims), at the A0/A6 4070 rates (graph engine, B ~1-2k) and a 3090 assumed 1.25x slower: v2 ~20 s (pair) / 40 s (square) / 70 s (2x3) per episode; longer probe routines scale with routine length (+clamp 1.7x, +tug/+moddiff 1.64x, all three 3.0x). Stage 1 nuis-canary (1 shard, 6 units: every shape at v2 and at the longest routine) measures the real s/episode from the unit sidecars (meta.episodes[].total_s_per_ep) before stage 2 is trusted; the main session may submit both stages together (canary has the lower priority number) and cancel stage 2 if the canary fails. T0 A2 on the free lane: A2_cost.csv measured 5.9 s/parent at 4 threads locally; 20 s/parent assumed at 1 thread.

groups.name: nuis-canary
groups.pilot: ESTIMATE from A0/A6 throughput (results/stageA/A0_throughput.csv, A6_summary.csv; 4070, 3090 x1.25); this canary is itself the measurement (meta.episodes total_s_per_ep)
groups.purpose: Canary for the nuisance-posterior task on a rented 3090: runs one unit per shape at probe v2 and at the longest probe routine, measuring seconds per SMC episode before the full nuisance grid.

groups.name: nuis-main
groups.pilot: ESTIMATE as nuis-canary: 224 units (160 main delta 0.08 x 5 probe sets, 64 delta-sweep v2), ~86k box-s total / 224 = 385 s per unit; to be replaced by the canary's measured s/episode
groups.purpose: Full nuisance-marginalised T1 posterior ambiguity grid: decides whether active probing returns as a headline (A2/A3 thresholds) and gives the measured ambiguity-vs-heterogeneity curve for figure F1.

groups.name: nuis-t0-a2
groups.pilot: local runner run cfcap.runner t0_a2 --seeds 5000:5010 --per-unit 5 --threads 1 ($CFCAP_OUT/nuisance/runs/a2local): 159 s for 10 parents = 15.9 s/parent at 1 thread (max 67 s); 20 s/parent kept for the tail
groups.purpose: Scale the Stage A2/A3 T0 oracle ambiguity estimate from 100 to 1100 parents so the 0.02 percent pilot becomes a measured rate with a tight interval.
